props.gloss_en: the mishnah: the cow of R' Elazar ben Azarya [went out with a strap between its horns, against the Sages' will]
Rav: R' Elazar ben Azarya would tithe twelve thousand calves from his herds every year
the cow was not his; it was his neighbour's
and because he did not protest against her, it is called by his name
the stam: throughout Seder Moed, wherever this pair appears, take out R' Yochanan and put in R' Yonatan
whoever could protest against the members of his household and did not is apprehended for the members of his household
[could protest against] the people of his town [and did not] -- he is apprehended for the people of his town
[could protest against] the whole world [and did not] -- he is apprehended for the whole world
Rav Pappa: and those of the Exilarch's house are apprehended for the whole world
R' Chanina: what is that which is written 'the Lord will enter into judgment with the elders of His people and its princes' (Isa 3:14)?
R' Chanina: if the princes sinned, what did the elders sin? Rather say: [He enters into judgment] with the elders, for they did not protest against the princes
a woman came crying out before Shmuel, and he paid no attention to her
Rav Yehuda: does the master not hold 'whoever stops his ear at the cry of the poor, he too shall cry and not be answered' (Prov 21:13)?
Shmuel: sharp one, your head [is] in cold water, the head of your head in hot water; here sits Mar Ukva, the av beit din
as it is written: 'house of David, thus says the Lord: execute judgment in the morning and rescue the robbed from the hand of the oppressor, lest My fury go forth like fire...' (Jer 21:12)
R' Zeira to R' Simon: let the master reprimand those of the Exilarch's house
R' Simon: they will not accept it from me
R' Zeira: even though they will not accept it, let the master reprimand them
R' Acha b. R' Chanina: never did a good thing go out from the mouth of the Holy One and He retract it for evil, except this matter
R' Acha: as it is written 'go through the midst of the city... and set a tav on the foreheads of the men who sigh and cry over all the abominations done in its midst' (Ezek 9:4)
God to Gabriel: go and inscribe on the foreheads of the righteous a tav of ink, so that the angels of destruction will not rule over them
God to Gabriel: and on the foreheads of the wicked a tav of blood, so that the angels of destruction will rule over them
God, answering the attribute of justice's 'how do these differ from those?': these are wholly righteous and those wholly wicked
the attribute of justice: it was in their [the righteous'] hands to protest, and they did not protest
God: it is revealed and known before Me that had they protested against them, they would not have accepted it from them
the attribute of justice: if it is revealed before You, to them who revealed it?

R' Acha: and that is what is written 'old, young, maiden, child and women slay utterly... and begin at My sanctuary' (Ezek 9:6), and it is written 'and they began with the elders who were before the house'
Rav Yosef taught: read not 'My sanctuary' (mikdashi) but 'My sanctified ones' (mekudashai) -- these are people who fulfilled the whole Torah from alef to tav
R' Acha: and immediately -- 'and behold six men came from the way of the upper gate... and they came and stood beside the bronze altar' (Ezek 9:2)
was there a bronze altar? [rather] the Holy One said to them: begin from the place where they say song before Me
and who are the six men? Rav Chisda: Fury, Wrath, Rage, Destroyer, Breaker and Annihilator
Rav: [why tav?] tav -- 'you shall live' (tichye)
Rav: tav -- 'you shall die' (tamut)
Shmuel: [tav --] the merit of the Patriarchs has ceased (tamah)
R' Yochanan: [tav --] the merit of the Patriarchs will show grace (tachon)
Reish Lakish: tav is the end of the Holy One's seal
R' Chanina: the seal of the Holy One is 'truth' (emet)
R' Shmuel bar Nachmani: [tav --] these are people who fulfilled the whole Torah from alef to tav
from when did the merit of the Patriarchs cease? Rav: from the days of Hoshea ben Beeri
Rav: as it is said 'I will uncover her shame in the sight of her lovers, and no man shall rescue her from My hand' (Hos 2:12)
Shmuel: from the days of Chazael
Shmuel: as it is said 'and Chazael king of Aram oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz' (II Kgs 13:22)
Shmuel: and it is written 'and the Lord was gracious to them... for the sake of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob... until now' (II Kgs 13:23)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: from the days of Eliyahu

R' Yehoshua ben Levi: as it is said 'at the time of the afternoon offering Eliyahu the prophet approached and said: Lord, God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, today let it be known that You are God in Israel...' (I Kgs 18:36)
R' Yochanan: from the days of Chizkiyahu
R' Yochanan: as it is said 'for the increase of the realm and for peace without end... from now and forever, the zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this' (Isa 9:6)
